description: Operationele punten van het Infrabel netwerk is a dataset listed in Infrabel open data portal, an open data portal of a railway infrastructure manager, published or maintained by Infrabel. Opdeling van het spoornetwerk volgens de eigenschappen van de infrastructuur en de operationele mogelijkheden. Deze lijst bevat de locatie, maar ook de verschillende officiële benamingen van de operationele punten, evenals een classificatie Belangrijk: Deze operationele punten moeten geanalyseerd worden samen met de data over lijnsecties aangezien ze de begin- en eindpunten van de secties weergeven. Coverage: Belgium. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Infrastructuur, Geolocatie. Its keywords are Geolocalisatie, Sporen, Stations, station. The portal shows 2026-08-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open licentie CC0 - Universeel (https://infrabel.opendatasoft.com/pages/license/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-infrabel-open-data-portal.
